message:
test(viewer): S12 observes the forced IDR on the wire and asserts that exact IDR was shown (F-22)

The product encoder may be asynchronous: SendFrame(true) can emit the previous P (or nothing)
and the forced IDR leaves in a later call. S12 asserted corrupted_keys()==1 and goodIdr!=0 right
after the forcing call, so it failed in a release sweep and in a standalone run (F-22).

Harness only, no product change: send_key_and_wait_on_wire forces one key and then sends plain
pictures (at most 30 calls / 1500 ms) until keyframes_sent shows the IDR on the wire; the
corrupted_keys()==1 assertion is unchanged, just placed after that observation, and is repeated
after the good IDR and at the end (exactly one zeroed IDR). The good IDR's seq is the observed
last_key_seq, and "shown" now requires that exact seq to be published as a key frame
(published_key), so a later P or a 0 sentinel cannot pass. The call order is only logged
("S12 order"); the async shape was observed in 2 of 5 standalone runs and passed.

Standalone x5 PASS, full sweep 38/40 with the two environment failures (e2e port held by the
live host, GDI capture fps). Product binaries sha256 unchanged; the 0.2.103 installer stays.
Ledger F-22 fixed, history #412.
